profit_quality.assessment: Use the three-year median operating free cash flow of HK$526.443 million as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, then apply a 0.75 haircut. 2024 and 2025 cash generation was strong, but 2023 was near break-even/free-cash-flow negative and game revenue depends on continuing advertising, content refresh and R&D.
adjustments: Started from operating cash flow rather than reported net profit to force profit-to-cash conversion into the denominator.
Deducted purchases of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets as capital expenditure.

Excluded investment gains/dividends conceptually by checking company-disclosed core business profit; 2025 core business profit was HK$566.714 million versus reported parent net profit HK$580.493 million.
Applied a profit haircut for game lifecycle volatility, user acquisition spending dependence, and the weak 2023 base.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating free cash flow was HK$-5.349 million in 2023, HK$986.982 million in 2024 and HK$526.443 million in 2025; three-year median is HK$526.443 million.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Cash conversion is acceptable in 2024-2025, but the 2023 trough and ongoing advertising/R&D needs prevent using a near-1.0 factor.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: 2025 operating cash flow / parent net profit was about 1.18x, but 2025 operating cash generation benefited from interest received and still had working-capital outflows in payables/deferred revenue.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: The report does not split maintenance and growth capex; full 2025 capex of HK$156.320 million is deducted in the free-cash-flow denominator.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2025 working capital consumed cash through lower payables/deferred revenue and higher inventories/receivables/prepayments; the cash-flow-based denominator already captures this.
